CHAPTER.CAPTION: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day.
CHAPTER.VERS: It is good to give thanks to Jehovah, and to make music to Your name, O Most High;
to declare Your lovingkindness in the morning, and Your faithfulness every night,
on an instrument of ten strings, on the lute, and on the harp, with resounding music.
For You, Jehovah, have made me glad through Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.
O Jehovah, how great are Your works! Your thoughts are very deep.
A brutish man does not know, nor does a fool understand this.
When the wicked spring up like grass, and when all the workers of iniquity blossom, it is that they may be destroyed forever.
But You, Jehovah, are on high forever.
For lo, Your enemies, O Jehovah, for lo, Your enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
But my horn You have exalted like an oryx; I have been anointed with fresh oil.
My eye also shall see my desire upon my enemies; my ears shall hear my desire upon the wicked who rise up against me.
The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
Those who are planted in the house of Jehovah shall flourish in the courts of our God.
They shall still bear fruit in old age; they shall be fat and luxuriant;
to declare that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.
